meta.product: MR conventional magnet line (1.5 tesla and 3 tesla scanners built around a helium-cooled superconducting magnet)
meta.tolerance_line: An install more than 30 days late breaches tolerance, and a line stop longer than 30 days breaches tolerance.
meta.confidence_basis: Eleven lenses agreed on both axes and on which node each future breaks on. The dates after 2028 are votes on undated events, and the numbers that decide whether a break is real, helium cover days, logic stock weeks and the cold-head parent's revenue share, are Placeholders that no owner has confirmed. Every internal value in this run is synthetic.

risks.name: United States magnet plant
risks.sentence: One plant winds and tests every magnet for the Americas and Europe, and a storm, a strike or a grid curtailment stops it with nothing to cover.

risks.name: China plant
risks.sentence: One plant builds every magnet and system for Asia inside a counterparty's borders, and a listing or a trade rupture strands it.

risks.name: United States hub
risks.sentence: One site assembles every system for two regions, so any stop there delays every install at once.

risks.name: Superconducting wire
risks.sentence: Every conventional magnet is wound from one mill's superconducting wire, and qualifying a second mill takes longer than the backlog covers.

risks.name: Cold heads
risks.sentence: One maker in Japan supplies the cold heads that keep every magnet cold, and without one a magnet cannot ship or stay cold in the field.

risks.name: Programmable logic
risks.sentence: The control electronics for every system use programmable logic that a foundry interruption or an entity listing can stop.

risks.name: Technicians
risks.sentence: The winding and cryogenic trades at the United States plant live in one town, and a strike or a retirement cliff cuts output without any supplier failing.

risks.name: Helium cover
risks.sentence: Helium cover at the United States plant is shorter than the time to reroute a shipment, so any interruption to power, road or port reaches the line.

uncertainties.question: Does something outside the OEM stop a part or a lane for more than 30 days before 2031?
uncertainties.end_a: No. Every measure stays a cost. Tariffs, payment friction and customs time raise the bill and stay inside the 30-day line.
uncertainties.end_b: Yes. A producer country lists wire, niobium or cold heads for export control, an entity listing cuts the parts flow through the China plant, or a sole supplier's owner leaves MR.
uncertainties.lean_sentence: Leaning weakly toward no. The Section 232 medical investigation had no proclamation on 11 October 2026, the China truce holds to its notice date, and no listing names wire or cold heads.
uncertainties.settles_a: The 2027 sourcing cycle closes with the truce renewed, the Section 232 report confined to finished scanners, and no listing of wire, niobium or cold heads.
uncertainties.settles_b: A Federal Register, MOFCOM or producer-country notice names any of those parts, an entity listing names the China plant or its logic supplier, or a parent announces the sale or closure of the wire mill or the cold-head plant.

uncertainties.question: In 2031, does helium still decide whether a magnet ships?
uncertainties.end_a: Yes. The Gulf route stays impaired or allocated, most new builds are still conventional, and a sealed magnet still needs a helium delivery at cool-down and test.
uncertainties.end_b: No. Helium returns to a buyers' market or sealed magnets take most new builds with a small test draw, so the cold head becomes the part that keeps every magnet cold.
uncertainties.lean_sentence: Leaning clearly toward yes. The Gulf strait saw four transits against a normal 85 on 11 October 2026, helium is bought on allocation letters, and no 3 tesla sealed magnet has been cleared.
uncertainties.settles_a: A United States helium allocation or export rule is proposed, the Gulf repair slips past 2028, or the sealed test draw is confirmed as a delivery-sized quantity.
uncertainties.settles_b: The Gulf strait reopens to insured traffic and the allocation letters stop, a 3 tesla sealed magnet is cleared, or the test draw is confirmed as a cylinder rather than a delivery.

futures.name: Cost only, helium still decides
futures.sentence: Trade stays a cost and magnets still need helium, so the clock on every delivery is a container, a grid and a road, not a rule.
futures.what_happens: The truce is renewed and no part is listed. The Gulf route stays near closed and both plants buy helium on allocation, the United States plant from domestic and Canadian sources and the China plant at the back of the Asian spot queue. Conventional builds still dominate because no 3 tesla sealed magnet is cleared. Both United States sites run winters under elevated grid ratings from 2027, and the helium cover thins each year because it is inventory bought at a 4 percent rate against rising prices.

path.sentence: The truce is renewed at its notice date, the Gulf route stays near closed, and a container fleet with a 35 to 48 day hold sets the helium cover at the United States plant while the Carolinas grid is rated elevated from 2027.
Conventional builds still dominate, the Midcontinent grid is rated high from the winter of 2028, and the helium cover thins each budget round as rates and input prices stay up.

what_fails_first.sentence: Helium cover at the United States magnet plant. A winter curtailment or a flood takes the liquefier's power and the trailer road while the next container is still in its hold, and the cover runs out before the delivery lands.
what_fails_first.tag: Placeholder on the days of cover; Panel judgement on the path

futures.how_soon: The winter of 2028 to 2029. A storm of the 2018 inland flood class can bring it forward to any hurricane season from 2027. The China plant's allocation queue is the second break, pushing Asian installs past the 30-day line in the first half of 2028.
futures.what_it_costs: One line stop at the United States magnet plant of 30 to 45 days and one quarter of Western Hemisphere installs more than 30 days late. Asian installs breach on the allocation schedule. Share does not move, because every supplier is short of helium together.
futures.what_prevents_it: Logistics holds the cover at the United States plant above the container hold plus the ten-day grid rebuild, and Site operations puts the liquefier on backup power off the plant feeder, both in place before the winter of 2028, so started by the second quarter of 2027.

how_sure.basis: Low to moderate. The fleet, the hold window, the grid ratings and the allocation letters are on dated public sources, but the path from an elevated grid rating to a multi-week curtailment has no record yet, the cover days are a Placeholder, and the panel split six to five on which plant breaks first.

futures.what_would_change_this: A 3 tesla sealed clearance or the Gulf route reopening moves this to F2. A United States helium allocation rule moves it toward F3. A confirmed cover figure above 60 days removes the United States break and leaves the China plant's queue as the first break.

futures.name: Cost only, helium no longer decides
futures.sentence: Trade stays a cost and by 2031 helium no longer decides whether a magnet ships, so the one part that keeps every magnet cold is a cold head from one maker.
futures.what_happens: The truce is renewed and parts flow at a tariff cost. The Gulf route reopens and the allocation letters stop. Sealed 1.5 tesla magnets build service history and European tenders pull sealed designs. A 3 tesla sealed magnet is cleared, the test draw proves to be a cylinder, and sealed designs take most new builds and the European replacement wave. The magnet is still wound from one mill's wire, and one Japanese cold head now carries the whole thermal load of every new magnet with no helium reserve behind it.

path.sentence: The truce is renewed, the Gulf route reopens to insured traffic, and sealed 1.5 tesla magnets cleared at three makers build service history while European tenders pull sealed designs.
A 3 tesla sealed magnet is cleared, sealed designs take most new builds, helium becomes a service matter, and the plant floor changes trade from helium handling to vacuum and cryocooler work.

what_fails_first.sentence: Cold heads. The sole maker supplies both new builds and the spares of a sealed fleet that warms when a cold head fails, so an earthquake or a plant outage at the maker stops both magnet plants at once.
what_fails_first.tag: Panel judgement; the maker's location is AI-suggested and Engineering confirms it against the Nankai Trough zone

futures.how_soon: The window opens once the sealed share passes half of output, placed in 2029, and runs to 2031. The event itself has no schedule.
futures.what_it_costs: A line stop longer than 30 days at both plants, because they share the cold head and 18 months of requalification outlasts any inventory. Installed sealed magnets that lose a cold head warm up while service competes with new builds for the part, so the hospital sees a dark scanner, not a slow install.
futures.what_prevents_it: Engineering with Sourcing qualifies a second cold-head source on the sealed design before the sealed share passes half, or the design carries a tested hold that buys 30 days without a working cold head, started by mid-2027 given 18 months of requalification.

how_sure.basis: High that wire and the cold head are unchanged sole-source parts in 2031. Moderate that the cold head breaks rather than costs. Low on the date, because the trigger has no schedule.

futures.what_would_change_this: A second cold-head maker cleared on the sealed design before 2029 turns the break into a cost. A delivery-sized test draw pulls this future back toward F1. No 3 tesla sealed clearance by 2028 defers it past the horizon.

futures.name: A part stops, helium still decides
futures.sentence: A state stops a part before 2031 while magnets still need helium to ship, so the stop lands on the plant inside a counterparty's borders and the other plant cannot cover for it.
futures.what_happens: The truce lapses at its notice date and entity listings in 2027 name the China plant's logic supplier and a cryogenic parts route. The Gulf route stays near closed, so helium at both plants is bought on allocation letters. Two blocs harden. The China plant builds for Asia without United States-origin logic, the United States plant keeps shipping on allocated helium but cannot cover Asia because its ramp and test capacity is sized for one hemisphere, and payment rails and customs become a licence queue.

path.sentence: The truce lapses at its notice date, entity listings in 2027 name the China plant's logic supplier and a cryogenic parts route, and helium at both plants stays on allocation.
Two blocs harden, the China plant builds for Asia without United States-origin logic, its lanes to Japan and India run under grey-zone pressure, and payment rails split by bloc.

what_fails_first.sentence: The China plant. It sits inside a counterparty's borders and holds weeks of programmable logic, not months, so an entity listing on its logic supplier stops the control electronics for every system it builds.
what_fails_first.tag: AI-suggested on what the plant imports and how much it holds; Sourcing confirms

futures.how_soon: Within one quarter of the first entity listing, inside the 2027 sourcing cycle. The first read is the second half of 2027. An investigation under the amended Chinese cyber law with a payment freeze is the earlier door to the same stop.
futures.what_it_costs: A line stop at the China plant longer than 30 days with no second plant able to cover Asia. Asian installs run more than 30 days late for two quarters or more, and share moves in Japan and India because a competitor outside the bloc keeps delivering. Helium cover at the United States plant breaches second, by early 2028.
futures.what_prevents_it: Sourcing holds logic and cold-head inventory at the China plant longer than the licence queue, started before the truce notice date, and Engineering qualifies a logic path that is not United States-origin for the Asian build, started by the first quarter of 2027.

how_sure.basis: The listing tools exist and were used on this sector in 2025, and geography fixes which plant a listing strands. The date rests on the truce notice and on an unpublished licence approval rate.

futures.what_would_change_this: The truce renewed at its notice date with no listing naming the plant or its suppliers. A listing that names cold heads before logic moves the break to the cold head and delays it a quarter. The Gulf route reopening makes this a one-hemisphere future.

futures.name: A part stops, helium no longer decides
futures.sentence: Sealed magnets take most new builds behind a trade wall, and the stop lands on the cold head that now keeps every magnet cold.
futures.what_happens: The truce lapses and the first measures are tariffs and a listing on control logic that the China plant absorbs with stock raised after the notice. The Gulf route reopens and helium becomes a cost line. Sealed magnets take most new builds and a 3 tesla clearance arrives by 2028. United States hospitals defer orders in 2027 and the OEM slips down its suppliers' queues. The cold-head maker's parent, for whom MR is a minority of revenue, fills its order book with fusion, physics and quantum work, and a producer-country notice lists 4 kelvin cryocoolers as dual use, closing the licence route for the China plant just as Europe's replacement orders rise.

path.sentence: The truce lapses, tariffs and a logic listing are absorbed with stock, the Gulf route reopens, sealed magnets take most new builds and a 3 tesla clearance arrives by 2028 while United States hospitals defer orders.

The cold-head maker's parent allocates capacity to better-paying buyers, a producer-country notice lists cryocoolers as dual use, and Europe's replacement peak lands on a line with no cold heads and no helium fallback.

what_fails_first.sentence: Cold heads. The one qualified maker's parent allocates capacity to better-paying buyers and the listing removes the licence route, and every magnet shipped or in the field depends on the part.
what_fails_first.tag: AI-suggested; Engineering confirms the maker's location and ownership, Sourcing confirms the parent's MR share

futures.how_soon: By 2029. Lead time passes 30 days within a quarter of the allocation letter, and a second maker takes 18 months to qualify, so the gap runs into 2030.
futures.what_it_costs: Both plants stop for longer than 30 days, for most of 18 months. Every backlog install runs past the tolerance line, the installed base breaches service cover because sealed magnets warm without a spare cold head, and the lateness lands on the European replacement peak so share moves. The highest bill of the four futures.
futures.what_prevents_it: Engineering and Sourcing qualify a second cold-head maker before 2029, which means starting by the second quarter of 2027, and Sourcing holds a multi-year supply agreement with the parent from the 2027 sourcing cycle.

how_sure.basis: The sole source, the parent's revenue mix and the 18-month requalification are carried from phase 2, and eight of eleven lenses land on this node. The date rests on an allocation nobody has announced and a listing that does not exist.

futures.what_would_change_this: A producer-country notice naming wire before cryocoolers moves the first break to the wire. No 3 tesla sealed clearance by 2028 collapses this future into F3. A parent announcing the sale or closure of the cold-head plant pulls the date to the announcement.

indicators.name: Federal Register actions naming the parts
indicators.what_is_measured: Any proclamation or Commerce rule naming finished MR scanners, superconducting wire, niobium, cryocoolers or cold heads, including the Section 232 medical equipment investigation opened 26 September 2025.
indicators.settles_a_when: The 2027 sourcing cycle closes with no document naming the parts, and the Section 232 medical action is confined to finished scanners or lapses.
indicators.settles_b_when: A document names wire, niobium, cryocoolers or cold heads, or a proclamation imposes a quota or licence on MR parts; the stop reaches N03, N05 or N17 within a quarter.
indicators.false_signal: Silence. A Section 232 report goes to the President unpublished, so no proclamation can mean a decision pending rather than no decision. An edit to the existing superconducting materials entry is not a new listing.
indicators.last_read: Zero Bureau of Industry and Security documents naming the parts, and no Section 232 medical proclamation, on 11 October 2026.

indicators.name: Entity List additions
indicators.what_is_measured: Bureau of Industry and Security rules adding parties, read for the China plant, its logic supplier, a cryogenic parts route or a Chinese wire mill.
indicators.source_name: Federal Register documents interface, Bureau of Industry and Security
indicators.cadence: On publication, several rules a quarter
indicators.settles_a_when: The truce notice renews with no addition touching medical electronics or cryogenic parts by the close of the 2027 sourcing cycle.
indicators.settles_b_when: A rule names the plant, its logic supplier or a logic distributor serving China; the stop follows within a quarter (future F3).
indicators.false_signal: A rule that only removes parties, or adds defence end users unrelated to imaging.
indicators.last_read: Newest action 24 August 2026, removals only; no addition touching the map.

indicators.name: China truce notice and counter-listings
indicators.what_is_measured: Whether the suspension of China's 24 percent additional tariff is renewed at its notice date, and whether a Ministry of Commerce announcement adds a wire mill, the cold-head maker, the OEM or a foreign-owned imaging plant to an export-control or unreliable-entity list.
indicators.source_name: State Council Tariff Commission notices and Ministry of Commerce announcements, read through wire reports and a law-firm tracker
indicators.cadence: Event driven; several announcements a month, checked quarterly
indicators.settles_a_when: The suspension is renewed for a year or longer and no 2026 or 2027 announcement names cryogenic or superconducting items or an imaging plant.
indicators.settles_b_when: The 24 percent duty returns, or an announcement names a cryocooler or wire maker or a foreign-owned imaging plant, or extends dual-use controls to cold heads bound for China.
indicators.false_signal: Quota and anti-dumping announcements, and batches that stay on defence firms.
indicators.last_read: Suspension in force from 10 November 2025 for one year, no renewal notice found; Announcement No. 46 of 9 October 2026 carries no export-control item. The truce end date reads 10 November 2026 or 10 January 2027 on two carried sources.

indicators.name: Sole-supplier parent filings
indicators.what_is_measured: Filings and press releases by the listed parents of the qualified wire mill and the two cryocooler makers, read for a sale, closure or market exit of the superconductor or cryocooler unit, and for how much of the backlog is fusion or physics work.
indicators.source_name: United States Securities and Exchange Commission EDGAR filing list; owners' press release pages
indicators.cadence: Within four days of an event for the listed parent; quarterly read of the press pages
indicators.settles_a_when: The 2027 sourcing cycle closes with no disposal and both parents still offer the MR part.
indicators.settles_b_when: A filing or release announces a sale or closure of the unit, or restricts it to research markets; this is the owner-exit route to a stop in futures F4 and F2.
indicators.false_signal: A backlog rise or a segment reshuffle that changes nothing on the shop floor.
indicators.last_read: No disposal filed on 11 October 2026. The United States second cryocooler source was bought and allocated to research in 2023 (predetermined element P18). The Japanese parent's investor address is still owed by Sourcing.

indicators.name: Export port closures and the longshore contract
indicators.what_is_measured: Dated closure advisories from the one export port, major work stoppages at ports and carriers, and the status of the longshore master contract expiring 30 September 2030.
indicators.source_name: Port authority advisories; Bureau of Labor Statistics Work Stoppages; longshore union site
indicators.cadence: Per event, daily in a storm; monthly stoppages file
indicators.settles_a_when: Closures stay at days through 2031 and the 2030 contract is renewed before expiry.
indicators.settles_b_when: One closure or stoppage at the port, the oversize carriers or the gas carriers runs past 30 days, or 30 September 2030 passes with no agreement.
indicators.false_signal: An inland-yard or gate-hours notice; a short strike with large headcount, such as the three-day port strike of October 2024.
indicators.last_read: No weather closure in 2026; newest advisory is a gate-hours notice of 23 September 2026. Contract approved 7 February 2025, runs to 30 September 2030.

indicators.name: European origin rule on medical tenders
indicators.what_is_measured: The status of Regulation (EU) 2025/1197, which bars Chinese-origin medical devices from tenders at or above 5 million euros, and any widening, counter-measure or withdrawal.
indicators.settles_a_when: The measure stays at its threshold or is withdrawn after a settlement; nothing stops.
indicators.settles_b_when: The threshold is removed, the measure extends to components, or a Chinese counter-rule bars foreign-built MR systems from Chinese hospitals.
indicators.false_signal: A European preference clause in the procurement directives, which scores origin rather than barring it.
indicators.last_read: In force since 20 June 2025 at the 5 million euro threshold; the page rendered empty on fetch on 11 October 2026, so the reading is carried from phase 2.

indicators.name: Gulf strait daily transits
indicators.what_is_measured: Ships broadcasting through the Strait of Hormuz each day, the lane Gulf helium leaves by, against a typical 85 a day.
indicators.cadence: Daily rows, published weekly, last three days open to revision
indicators.settles_a_when: The count stays below about 40 a day through 2028 and war-risk cover stays withdrawn, or a United States allocation rule arrives.
indicators.settles_b_when: The count holds above about 70 a day for two consecutive quarters, insured container traffic resumes and allocation letters stop.
indicators.false_signal: A one-week jump from convoyed tankers. The count is all ships, not helium carriers; transits can recover while Qatar's liquefaction is still being rebuilt.
indicators.last_read: Four ships on 4 October 2026 against a typical 85.

indicators.name: Helium price and import mix
indicators.what_is_measured: The posted Grade-A base price per cubic metre and United States import shares by origin from the annual survey; the quarterly bulk contract price by region under allocation; the producer price index for industrial gases.
indicators.source_name: United States Geological Survey Mineral Commodity Summaries, helium chapter; IMARC bulk helium price index; Bureau of Labor Statistics series PCU325120325120
indicators.cadence: Annual in February; quarterly for the bulk index; monthly for the producer index
indicators.settles_a_when: The base price rises two editions running with surcharges still posted, the Qatari share falls further, and the United States bulk price holds above 100,000 dollars a tonne through 2027.
indicators.settles_b_when: The surcharge sentence disappears, the base price falls two editions running, and the bulk price falls two quarters running with spot availability.
indicators.false_signal: A lower posted base price with surcharges still posted, because allocation lives in the surcharge. A producer-index fall driven by argon and oxygen.
indicators.last_read: About 12 dollars per cubic metre in 2025 from 14 in 2024, surcharges posted; Canada 47 percent, Qatar 28 percent of imports for 2021 to 2024 (USGS, February 2026, carried from phase 2). Producer index up 5.4 percent in the year to August 2026.

indicators.name: United States helium export or allocation rule
indicators.what_is_measured: Any Federal Register rule or presidential document naming helium with export, allocation or Section 232.
indicators.settles_a_when: A rule is proposed or signed; it also moves U1 toward a stop for the China plant, which cannot buy Chinese helium.
indicators.settles_b_when: None appears while Gulf transits recover.
indicators.false_signal: A Bureau of Land Management lease or royalty notice naming helium, which is land administration.
indicators.last_read: No rule existed on 11 October 2026; the address is built on the confirmed interface pattern but was not fetched this round.

indicators.name: Sealed magnets in new United States clearances
indicators.what_is_measured: New 510(k) clearances in product code LNH (magnetic resonance diagnostic device), read for the first 3 tesla sealed magnet and for the sealed share of new clearances.
indicators.cadence: Weekly refresh; quarterly read of each summary's cryostat section
indicators.settles_a_when: No 3 tesla sealed clearance appears by the 2027 sourcing cycle and sealed designs stay a minority through 2028.
indicators.settles_b_when: A 3 tesla sealed clearance lands, sealed designs pass half of new clearances in a rolling year, and Engineering confirms the test draw as a cylinder (Placeholder).
indicators.false_signal: A 3 tesla clearance for a software or coil change on a conventional platform; several K numbers for one platform family; a run of low-field or portable clearances, which feed the fifth-future watch row rather than end B.
indicators.last_read: 21 clearances in 2026 to 16 September; five name a sealed or helium-light cryostat, all at or below 1.5 tesla; no 3 tesla sealed clearance.

series.basis: sealed or helium-light records among 21 LNH clearances in 2026, read from summaries

indicators.name: Second 4 kelvin cold-head source
indicators.what_is_measured: Whether any maker other than the sole Japanese group lists a 4 kelvin Gifford-McMahon cold head, which settles the six-to-five split on whether the cold head breaks or costs when helium no longer decides.
indicators.source_name: Product pages of the United States cryocooler maker on the map
indicators.settles_a_when: No second 4 kelvin Gifford-McMahon source exists, so at end B the cold head is a single point with no spare design.
indicators.settles_b_when: A second maker lists a 4 kelvin cold head, or a sealed magnet is cleared on a pulse-tube cooler.
indicators.false_signal: A 4 kelvin pulse-tube cryostat on the same page, which is not a drop-in cold head.
indicators.last_read: On 11 October 2026 the second maker lists Gifford-McMahon coolers only at 20 to 80 kelvin and reaches 4 kelvin only as a pulse tube; no drop-in second source.

indicators.name: Winter grid rating at the two United States sites
indicators.what_is_measured: The winter risk rating and extreme-scenario reserve margin for the regions covering the magnet plant and the hub.
indicators.source_name: North American Electric Reliability Corporation, Winter Reliability Assessment
indicators.cadence: Annual, each November; read each quarter against the plant's backup-power Placeholder
indicators.settles_a_when: A region is rated high and a multi-week curtailment reaches the plant while the Gulf is still impaired, because the liquefier stops and helium cover becomes the margin.
indicators.settles_b_when: It cannot settle end B; a normal rating only removes one route to end A.
indicators.false_signal: A cold-snap advisory that lifts in days.
indicators.last_read: Carolinas rated elevated from 2027 and Midcontinent high from winter 2028 in the January 2026 long-term assessment; the 2025 winter assessment is the carried address.

actions.name: Confirm the Placeholders that decide the pages
actions.principle: Value and resiliency layer: the baseline
actions.protects: Every risk. The cover days at the United States plant, the backup power, the sealed test draw in litres, the cold-head and wire addresses against the Nankai Trough zone, the China plant's logic stock in weeks and the price at which the OEM loses its helium allocation decide whether the first break on each page is real.
actions.why_now: Every other action is sized from these numbers, and all of them are synthetic today. Eleven of eleven lenses rank this first or second.
actions.too_late_after: The 2027 sourcing cycle opens on synthetic numbers
actions.act_if: Act now. Any function that has not returned a number by the end of 2026 is asked again.
actions.pause_if: Never.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if a confirmed value moves a first break by a quarter or turns a break into a cost.
actions.cost_of_waiting: A year of decisions sized on guesses. A capital plan built on synthetic numbers.

actions.name: Test a 30-day manual fallback at both plants and both sole suppliers against a 35-day loss of systems
actions.owner: Site operations with Sourcing, with the wire mill and the cold-head maker in the room
actions.principle: Resilient products and processes: business continuity
actions.protects: The United States plant, the China plant, the wire mill, the cold-head maker, the gas carriers and the port terminal. The 35-day encryption event is the one break every future carries, and it lands wherever each future's first break already sits.
actions.why_now: The shared break has no external clock, so the test is the only clock. Eleven of eleven lenses say it works in every future. The people who ran the line on paper are the ones nearest retirement.
actions.too_late_after: The first outage, or the retirement of the people who can write the procedure
actions.act_if: Act if any site cannot say today how it ships without its systems, or if a sole supplier or sector peer reports a systems outage of a week or more.
actions.pause_if: Pause once a site has passed a timed test twice.
actions.look_again_if: Look again after any systems migration, if a test fails, or if the drill assumed grid and roads were up.
actions.cost_of_waiting: One more year in which a 35-day stop breaches the line in every future and is largely uninsured, because cyber cover excludes state action.

actions.name: Qualify a second cold-head maker
actions.protects: The cold head, and through it both plants and the installed base. It removes the first break in F2 and F4 and cuts the cost of a cold-head outage in F1 and F3, where helium is the fallback. Four lenses (Foreign trade, Geopolitical, Technology shift, Contrarian) say it works in all four because the same cold head cools conventional magnets too; seven hold it to the sealed futures.
actions.why_now: Requalification takes 18 months, and F4 breaks by 2029. A start after mid-2027 lands after the break. The Contrarian's condition stands: one maker has already left the market, so the action is real only once Sourcing names a second maker with a letter of intent.
actions.act_if: Act if Sourcing names a second maker with a letter of intent, if the sealed share of clearances passes a quarter, or if a producer-country register names cryocoolers or cold heads.
actions.pause_if: Pause if no second maker exists (switch to A2 plus A7), or if the sealed share stays below a quarter in 2028 and conventional builds still dominate.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if the parent announces a review or exit of its cryogenics unit, if a second maker sits inside the same Nankai Trough shaking zone, or if the cold head's own sub-suppliers are shared (A24).
actions.cost_of_waiting: The second source lands after the F4 break and after a tender cycle; in F4 both plants stay stopped into 2030.

actions.name: Keep an offline, restore-tested copy of the design and qualification record
actions.principle: Resilient products and processes: IP ownership and continuity
actions.protects: The design and qualification record, and through it every 18-month requalification on the map. Every future page assumes the record is intact and nothing on the candidate list keeps it so.
actions.why_now: Added by Security and the Contrarian independently. A record loss turns every replacement time into an unknown, and the manual fallback (A9) is robust only inside this assumption.
actions.act_if: Act if a restore of the record has never been timed.
actions.pause_if: Pause if a timed restore inside 30 days already exists.
actions.look_again_if: Look again after any cyber event at the OEM or a sole supplier.
actions.cost_of_waiting: One more year with the assumption every page rests on unverified.

actions.name: Hold helium cover at the United States plant above the container hold plus the ten-day grid rebuild
actions.protects: Helium cover and the United States plant. It removes the first break in F1 and the second break in F3. In F2 and F4 it is carrying cost.
actions.why_now: The F1 break lands in the winter of 2028 to 2029 and can arrive in any hurricane season from 2027. Cover builds slowly at allocated volumes and cannot be bought once the shortage bites. The read date leans toward the two futures where it pays.
actions.act_if: Act if Logistics states cover below the container hold plus ten days, if Gulf transits stay below a quarter of normal into 2027, or if an allocation letter cuts the plant's monthly volume.
actions.pause_if: Pause if the Gulf strait reopens to insured traffic and the allocation letters stop.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if a United States helium allocation rule is proposed, if the sealed test draw is confirmed as a cylinder, or if A8 raises the plant's helium draw.
actions.cost_of_waiting: One 30 to 45 day stop at the United States plant and a quarter of Western installs late.

actions.name: Put the liquefier at the United States plant on backup power off the plant feeder
actions.protects: The United States plant and its helium cover. It covers the cheapest ordinary failure on the map, a winter curtailment, and is harmless elsewhere.
actions.why_now: The Carolinas grid is rated elevated from 2027 and the Midcontinent high from the winter of 2028. A generator takes a year to procure and data centres are buying the same units. The Contrarian warns the panel will under-rate it because it is small.
actions.start_by: The 2027 capital plan, procurement by mid-2027
actions.act_if: Act if Site operations confirms the liquefier shares the plant feeder, or if the grid operator issues a winter curtailment notice for the region.
actions.pause_if: Pause if the feeder is reclassified as critical load or cover at the plant reads above 60 days.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if the sealed share passes half, if the switchgear is reachable from the plant network, or if the backup fuel crosses the feeder's flood zone.
actions.cost_of_waiting: One winter in which the liquefier idles through the first curtailment.

actions.name: Hold logic and cold-head stock at the China plant longer than the licence queue
actions.protects: The China plant, its logic and its cold heads. It is the only action that moves before the first axis settles, and the nearest date on the list.
actions.why_now: The truce notice is first read as 10 November 2026. Stock bought after a listing may itself need a licence. Three lenses add F4, where the logic listing is absorbed with stock.
actions.too_late_after: An entity listing names the plant or its logic supplier
actions.act_if: Act if the truce is not renewed at its notice date, or if a listing names any supplier to the China plant.
actions.pause_if: Pause if the truce is renewed for a year or more with no listing.
actions.look_again_if: Look again once Sourcing states the stock in weeks, if the licence queue shortens, or if the warehouse sits in the flood plain.
actions.cost_of_waiting: The F3 break lands on empty shelves and the stop runs the full licence queue.

actions.name: Sign a multi-year supply agreement with the cold-head maker's parent, with a change-of-control clause and step-in rights to tooling and drawings
actions.protects: The cold head against owner exit. Nine lenses hold it to F4 because a contract moves neither a licence nor a flood. Financial says it works in all four if it carries a change-of-control clause.
actions.why_now: The 2027 sourcing cycle is the last normal negotiation before the parent's next capacity review. One sale document can end the line.
actions.too_late_after: The parent announces a sale, a review or an exit
actions.act_if: Act if the parent's filings show its cryogenics unit shrinking, under review or below group margin.
actions.pause_if: Pause if A1 qualifies a second maker, or if the parent invests in the plant.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if a listing names cryocoolers, if the parent changes hands, or if the yen moves more than fifteen percent against the dollar.
actions.cost_of_waiting: Negotiating from a queue; in F4 the whole gap uncovered.

actions.name: Confirm the control classifications of wire, cold heads and logic and the China plant's licence approval rate
actions.protects: The wire, the cold heads, the logic and the China plant. F3 and F4 rest on classifications nobody has checked, and magnet-grade wire has never been read against the dual-use lists.
actions.why_now: It costs nothing and decides whether A5 and A6 are bets or waste. Added by Geopolitical and Foreign trade independently.
actions.act_if: Act regardless.
actions.pause_if: Never.
actions.look_again_if: Look again at every control-list revision.
actions.cost_of_waiting: A5 and A6 are bought against a guess, and the sole wire source sits under an unknown rule.

actions.name: Run an annual credit and ownership watch on the wire mill and the cold-head parent
actions.protects: The wire and the cold head. The first axis counts an owner's exit as a stop, and an exit reads in filings before the press.
actions.why_now: Trivial cost. The cold-head parent's MR revenue share is itself a Placeholder.
actions.act_if: Act if either parent's relevant revenue falls under five percent of the group.
actions.pause_if: Never.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if ownership changes.
actions.cost_of_waiting: An exit seen in the press instead of in the filings a year earlier.

actions.name: Run a correlated-hazard test: one hurricane against the plant, the port and the helium lanes together, one Nankai event against the cold-head and compressor makers together
actions.protects: The United States plant, the export port, the gas carriers, the oversize road, the cold-head maker and the compressor maker. The candidate list tests nodes one at a time and weather does not.
actions.why_now: The continuity plan tests nodes singly. One Atlantic storm closes three nodes in a month.
actions.act_if: Act if the continuity plan tests nodes singly.
actions.pause_if: Never.
actions.look_again_if: Look again after each named storm.
actions.cost_of_waiting: One season exposed to a stop the single-node plans do not see.

actions.name: Qualify a logic path that is not United States-origin for the Asian build
actions.principle: Resilient products and processes: design ownership
actions.protects: The logic and the China plant. It shortens the F3 stop rather than preventing it, because 18 months from early 2027 lands at or after the break, and a foreign-made part can still be caught by the foreign direct product rule. Five lenses add F4, where it shortens the licence queue; the Contrarian notes it spends design ownership.
actions.why_now: Only a start in the first quarter of 2027 lands before 2029.
actions.act_if: Act if an entity listing names the China plant's logic supplier, or if licence approvals stay below half for two quarters.
actions.pause_if: Pause if the truce is renewed with no listing, or if A5 covers the licence queue.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if the foreign direct product rule reaches this product class, or if a second foundry clears equivalent parts.
actions.cost_of_waiting: A 2029 answer to a 2027 break; the F3 stop runs the full queue.

actions.name: Size ramp and test capacity at the United States plant to cover part of the Asian build
actions.protects: The China plant's customers. It is the only action that keeps an Asian delivery date when the China plant stops. It is useless in F1, where the United States plant itself fails, and it raises the helium draw at that plant, so the 2027 capital plan must size it with A3.
actions.why_now: Capacity takes 24 months to change and the 2027 capital plan is the only slot. It carries the heaviest working-capital drag on the list.
actions.act_if: Act if a listing names the China plant or its logic supplier, or if the plant's stock falls below the licence queue.
actions.pause_if: Pause if the truce is renewed through 2028, or if a second Asian site is approved.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if helium cover cannot carry the extra draw, if the technicians cannot staff a second shift, or if Asian tenders add local-content rules.
actions.cost_of_waiting: An Asian tender cycle lost; the F3 lane idles two more years.

actions.name: Design and test a hold that keeps a sealed magnet cold for 30 days without a working cold head
actions.protects: The cold head and the sealed installed base. The Contrarian notes the physics may not allow it, so the first step is a cheap study.
actions.why_now: It binds once the sealed share passes half, placed in 2029.
actions.start_by: A study in 2027; the design by 2028
actions.act_if: Act if the sealed share passes a quarter of new builds, or if the study shows a hold above 30 days.
actions.pause_if: Pause if A1 qualifies a second maker, or if the study shows a hold under ten days.
actions.look_again_if: Look again when Engineering states the test draw, or if a conduction-cooled design appears in clearances.
actions.cost_of_waiting: Low until 2028; then a year of sealed fleet with no hold.

actions.name: Build the trade pipeline at the United States plant before the conversion decision
actions.protects: The technicians and the United States plant. Competence takes 18 months and the retirement curve is unmeasured. A retired trade cannot be bought back as a part can.
actions.why_now: The two lines need different trades, and hiring for 2029 starts in 2027.
actions.act_if: Act if more than a quarter of winders and cryogenic technicians retire within five years.
actions.pause_if: Pause if automation removes winding from the floor.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if a competing local employer closes.
actions.cost_of_waiting: A cohort not competent until 2030.

actions.name: Map contract expiries at the plants, the hub and the ports against storm and winter windows
actions.protects: The plants, the hub and the export port. The longshore master contract expires on 30 September 2030, inside hurricane season; a port expiry in a storm month is two stops in one.
actions.why_now: A week of work and nothing to buy.
actions.act_if: Act if any contract expires in 2027 or 2028.
actions.pause_if: Never.
actions.look_again_if: Look again annually.
actions.cost_of_waiting: A known date arrives unplanned.

actions.name: Rewrite delivery clauses, agree a late-delivery remedy script and publish delivery performance before health systems do
actions.owner: Install PMO with the S&OP council
actions.protects: Share. It changes what a late install costs, not whether it happens. All four futures breach the line somewhere, and whether tenders score late delivery at all is unverified.
actions.why_now: Frameworks renew on multi-year cycles.
actions.too_late_after: A health system publishes delivery scores first
actions.act_if: Act if a large customer adds delivery scoring.
actions.pause_if: Pause if tenders never score reliability.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if competitors publish first.
actions.cost_of_waiting: A cycle of unmanaged scores and the first breach's share.

actions.name: Set an allocation rule for scarce magnets
actions.protects: Share where the OEM is one of two or three suppliers. It is a cost modifier in every future.
actions.why_now: The first stop will otherwise be allocated by order date.
actions.act_if: Act if any plant stops.
actions.pause_if: Never.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if tender scoring changes.
actions.cost_of_waiting: The first stop is allocated by order date.

actions.name: Pre-permit an oversize route to a second export port and hold a pre-season helium position there
actions.protects: The export port and the gas carriers. It covers delay in all four futures and a stop only in F1 and F3, where the helium position matters.
actions.why_now: Hurricane season is annual and the single port closes for days in every future.
actions.too_late_after: A closure longer than ten days
actions.act_if: Act if the port closes for ten days, or if its log shows a stop over ten days.
actions.pause_if: Pause if a second berth is contracted, or if cover exceeds the longest closure.
actions.look_again_if: Look again after any bridge posting, or if the second port shares the storm track.
actions.cost_of_waiting: A season of held exports.

actions.name: Contract a second cryogenic carrier with an inland transfer point
actions.protects: The gas carriers and the helium cover. The encryption event at a carrier empties the cover and stops the plant for 50 to 60 days.
actions.why_now: One carrier holds most deliveries.
actions.act_if: Act if one carrier holds over two thirds of deliveries.
actions.pause_if: Pause if cover at the plant reaches 90 days.
actions.look_again_if: Look again yearly.
actions.cost_of_waiting: One more year of the carrier break.

actions.name: Fix helium allocation priority in writing, indexed to a published price, on a lane that avoids the Gulf strait and sanctioned payment rails
actions.protects: The helium supply and the cover. The price at which the OEM loses its allocation is a Placeholder, and without a written priority A3 cannot be built at allocated volumes.
actions.why_now: A chip plant can take priority at any time.
actions.too_late_after: A buyers' market returns or a chip plant takes priority
actions.act_if: Act if a chip plant is reported taking priority, or if Qatar's share of United States imports falls further.
actions.pause_if: Pause if the Gulf strait reopens and a buyers' market returns.
actions.look_again_if: Look again at each allocation letter.
actions.cost_of_waiting: A3 becomes unbuildable.

actions.name: Hedge yen exposure on cold heads and compressors for the contract term
actions.protects: The cold-head and compressor bill. A cost smoother in every future.
actions.why_now: It starts with A2.
actions.act_if: Act if the Japanese central bank changes its rate path.
actions.pause_if: Pause if A2 is priced in dollars.
actions.look_again_if: Look again annually.
actions.cost_of_waiting: Low.

actions.name: Map the cold head's own sub-suppliers before signing a second maker
actions.protects: The cold head. A second maker fed by the same regenerator and displacer sources buys false diversity.
actions.why_now: A study of months that gates A1.
actions.act_if: Act when A1 starts.
actions.pause_if: Pause if the maker shows dual-sourced inputs.
actions.look_again_if: Look again at each qualification.
actions.cost_of_waiting: A1 may buy false diversity.

actions.name: Buy contingent business interruption cover naming the wire mill, the cold-head maker and the helium cover
actions.protects: The bill, not the break, and only if insurers write it. Cyber cover already excludes state action.
actions.why_now: Capacity is withdrawing.
actions.act_if: Act if a broker quotes cover naming the suppliers.
actions.pause_if: Pause if exclusions void it.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if the premium exceeds the cost of A5 stock.
actions.cost_of_waiting: One uninsured year.

actions.name: Require counterfeit avoidance and cyber attestation from sole suppliers and carriers
actions.protects: The wire, the cold head, the electronics, the carriers and the port. Attestation must not replace the tabletop in A9.
actions.why_now: F4 adds a grey-market cold head as a cost, and the OEM's own network is rarely the way in.
actions.act_if: Act if a counterfeit alert names any component class on the map.
actions.pause_if: Never.
actions.look_again_if: Look again at each sourcing cycle.
actions.cost_of_waiting: A year of unverified parts.

actions.name: Decide the OEM's own pace of conversion to sealed magnets, including whether the 3 tesla line converts
actions.principle: Resilient products and processes: engineering flexibility
actions.protects: This is a decision, not a hedge. It chooses which pair of futures the line lives in, trading a Gulf dependency (helium cover) for a Japanese one (the cold head). Waiting a year picks F1 and F3 by default. It raises the value of A1 and A9 if conversion makes one part hold every magnet.
actions.why_now: The 2027 capital plan. The two lines need different trades, and hiring for 2029 starts in 2027.
actions.act_if: Act if the test draw is confirmed as a cylinder and a 3 tesla sealed clearance is filed.
actions.pause_if: Pause if hospitals decline the first sealed option, if the test draw is delivery-sized, or if no second cold-head source exists.
actions.look_again_if: Look again if helium returns to a buyers' market, if a competitor clears 3 tesla sealed, or if tenders score helium independence.
actions.cost_of_waiting: Hiring the wrong trade or none, and one more year on helium terms.

brief.bottom_line: Every future breaks this line somewhere before 2031, and in every one the break lands on a node already on the risk list. Three actions pay whichever way the world goes: confirm the internal numbers the pages rest on, test a 30-day manual fallback at both plants and both sole suppliers, and start qualifying a second cold-head maker by the second quarter of 2027.
brief.where_we_are_heading: The read date leans toward trade staying a cost and helium still deciding whether a magnet ships. The Gulf strait saw four transits against a normal 85 on 11 October 2026, helium is bought on allocation letters, no listing names wire or cold heads, and no 3 tesla sealed magnet is cleared. Ten of twelve indicators lean that way; two lean neither. Nothing has settled.
brief.what_fails_first: On the lean, helium cover at the United States magnet plant, in the winter of 2028 to 2029, when a grid curtailment or a flood takes the liquefier's power and the trailer road while the next container is still in its hold. Any hurricane season from 2027 can bring it forward. The China plant's helium queue breaches second, in the first half of 2028. If a listing lands first, the China plant stops in the second half of 2027 through its logic supply. If helium leaves the story, one Japanese cold head stops both plants.
brief.what_it_costs: On the lean, one 30 to 45 day stop at the United States plant and a quarter of Western installs more than 30 days late, with share unmoved because every supplier is short of helium together. The costliest futures are the two where a part stops: the China plant off for a licence queue plus rehiring time with Asian share moving within one tender cycle, or both plants off for most of 18 months with the installed base warming and Europe's replacement peak going elsewhere.
brief.right_in_every_future: Confirm the Placeholders now: the cover days, the backup power, the sealed test draw in litres, the China plant's logic stock in weeks, the cold-head maker's address and its parent's MR share. Test a 30-day manual fallback with the wire mill and the cold-head maker in the room, because a 35-day encryption event breaches the line in all four futures and lands wherever each future's first break already sits. Keep an offline, restore-tested copy of the design record. Start a second cold-head maker by the second quarter of 2027, once Sourcing names one with a letter of intent.
brief.right_only_if_the_lean_holds: Helium cover at the United States plant above the container hold plus the ten-day grid rebuild, and the liquefier on backup power, both before the winter of 2028. They pay only where helium still decides, which is where the read date leans, and they are carrying cost if sealed magnets take most new builds. Stock at the China plant is a bet on a listing and has to be bought before the truce notice, first read as 10 November 2026. A multi-year agreement with the cold-head parent is a bet on an owner exit and does not survive a licence refusal.
brief.one_action_waiting: Confirm the Placeholders. It costs phone calls, it has named owners in Logistics, Site operations, Engineering and Sourcing, and until it is done every other action on this page is sized to a synthetic number.

evidence.claim: P1. Sealed, helium-light 1.5 tesla magnets are cleared products at three makers, cleared for the OEM's own platform on 5 February 2026. They still use niobium-titanium wire and a Gifford-McMahon cold head.
evidence.source: FDA K181479 (3 Aug 2018), K253779 (5 Feb 2026); technology lens
evidence.changes_if: A safety recall of the sealed class, or the OEM choosing not to convert its 3 tesla line. The conversion decision is the OEM's, not the world's.
evidence.confirm_by: No confirmation needed; dated public source

evidence.claim: P2. No 1.5 or 3 tesla magnet without niobium-titanium wire appears in United States clearance records to October 2026, and a new wire mill takes about 18 months to qualify, so wire stays the single most design-locked input through 2031.
evidence.source: openFDA read 11 Oct 2026; technology lens
evidence.changes_if: A high-temperature superconductor magnet cleared before 2028 and adopted at pace; no lens found evidence of either.
evidence.confirm_by: No confirmation needed; dated public source

evidence.claim: P3. Helium is a four-state market (United States 81, Qatar 63, Russia 18, Algeria 11 of 190 million cubic metres in 2025). Qatar's Ras Laffan complex was struck in March 2026, the energy minister put repairs at three to five years, Russian helium is barred from the United States and the European Union and self-licensed to 31 December 2027, Chinese helium is under an export ban with no end date, and the United States federal reserve was sold to a private firm on 27 June 2024. There is no public buffer anywhere.
evidence.source: USGS (Feb 2026); BLM (27 Jun 2024); Global Trade Alert; QatarEnergy statement via IOM3 (23 Mar 2026); geopolitical, financial, macroeconomic, infrastructure, foreign trade lenses
evidence.changes_if: Qatari helium units restarting much sooner than the minister's estimate. The macroeconomic lens notes a 6 March 2026 satellite analysis saying main equipment was intact and no producer disclosure confirms the helium units were hit. The repair timing is therefore moved to the uncertain list (U-H1).
evidence.confirm_by: No confirmation needed; dated public source

evidence.claim: P4. The United States magnet plant sits inside the only helium producer that is a net exporter. Qatar's share of United States helium imports fell from 40 to 28 percent and Canada's rose from 36 to 47 percent across the 2020 to 2024 windows, and the base price fell. The United States plant and the China plant face different helium worlds.
evidence.source: USGS (Jan 2025, Feb 2026); contrarian, geopolitical lenses
evidence.changes_if: A United States export control or allocation rule on helium, or a Cliffside or Hugoton outage coinciding with the Gulf outage.
evidence.confirm_by: No confirmation needed; dated public source

evidence.claim: P5. Helium moves in a fleet of roughly 500 to 700 40-foot ISO containers that hold liquid for about 35 to 48 days, with one maker behind most of them.
evidence.source: Linde product page (read 11 Oct 2026); consultancy analysis (1 Apr 2026), AI-suggested on fleet size
evidence.changes_if: A second container maker at scale, or a shift to air-shipped dewars; neither found.
evidence.confirm_by: No confirmation needed; dated public source

evidence.claim: P6. Niobium is 93 percent Brazilian from one family-controlled private producer; the United States is wholly import dependent; China takes 49 percent of Brazil's ferroniobium exports. Leverage on wire sits with one producer state and one dominant buyer and reaches the OEM through the mill, not the ore.
evidence.source: USGS (Feb 2026); geopolitical, financial, foreign trade lenses
evidence.changes_if: A Canadian or other second producer at scale before 2031; none is on a published schedule.
evidence.confirm_by: No confirmation needed; dated public source

evidence.claim: P7. United States import duties on wire, cold heads, logic, memory and graphics rest on Section 232 and Section 301 measures with no expiry after the Supreme Court ended emergency-power tariffs on 20 February 2026: 10 percent combined for the European Union, United Kingdom, Taiwan and Canada, 12.5 percent for Japan, South Korea, China and Brazil from 24 July 2026. A 50 percent tariff on the copper content of worked copper has applied since 1 August 2025. Magnet-grade niobium-titanium wire in a copper matrix sits outside the copper annex and outside the control lists.
evidence.source: Federal Register (5 Aug 2025); Supreme Court (20 Feb 2026); EY (Jul 2026); foreign trade, macroeconomic, contrarian lenses
evidence.changes_if: A trade deal that removes Section 232 measures, or a reclassification of the wire into the copper annex. The wire classification is AI-suggested; Sourcing confirms the declared code.
evidence.confirm_by: No confirmation needed; dated public source

evidence.claim: P8. The Section 232 investigation into medical equipment opened on 2 September 2025 names MRI machines in scope, and no proclamation had followed by 11 October 2026. The tools for restricting trade in finished scanners exist and are court-proof; whether they are used, and at what rate, is open.
evidence.source: Federal Register (26 Sep 2025); customer, contrarian lenses
evidence.changes_if: Not unmakeable as a tool. The outcome is uncertain (U-T1).
evidence.confirm_by: No confirmation needed; dated public source

evidence.claim: P9. The European Union has excluded Chinese-origin medical devices from public tenders at or above 5 million euros since 30 June 2025 with no expiry, and China barred European Union firms from imported-device procurement above 45 million yuan from 6 July 2025 while exempting products made in China. The China plant keeps Asian market access that a United States-built scanner loses, and is not a backup for Europe.
evidence.source: Regulation (EU) 2025/1197 (20 Jun 2025); CMS (Jul 2025); customer, geopolitical lenses
evidence.changes_if: Repeal of either measure; neither carries a sunset. Which plant serves which market is AI-suggested; the S&OP council confirms.
evidence.confirm_by: S&OP council

evidence.claim: P10. Cyber duties with dates inside the horizon are law: United States device cyber law since March 2023 with final guidance February 2026; the European Union Cyber Resilience Act reporting from 11 September 2026 and full application 11 December 2027 for bought-in electronics; the United States Coast Guard port cyber plan deadline 16 July 2027; Japan mandatory reporting from 1 October 2026; China's amended law from 1 January 2026.
evidence.source: Cornell LII; EUR-Lex 2024/2847; National Law Review (28 Jan 2025); security lens
evidence.changes_if: Repeal; none scheduled.
evidence.confirm_by: No confirmation needed; dated public source

evidence.claim: P11. An encrypted manufacturer takes five weeks or longer to restart on the 2025 record, which is past the 30-day tolerance line. Programmable logic was the most reported counterfeit part class in 2025 at more than 15 percent of reports. Cargo theft hit 2,646 confirmed incidents in 2025 with electronics the most targeted type.
evidence.source: BleepingComputer (15 Nov 2025); ERAI 2025 report; Verisk CargoNet (2026); security lens
evidence.changes_if: The recovery figure comes from a vehicle maker and a brewer, not a magnet maker; the inference to this line is Panel judgement.
evidence.confirm_by: No confirmation needed; dated public source

evidence.claim: P12. The United States manufacturing workforce had a median age of 43.9 in 2025, about a quarter is 55 or older, and the cohort turning 65 between 2025 and 2027 is the largest on record. Union density in South Carolina (2.8 percent) and Wisconsin (6.4 percent) sits far below the national rate, so slow attrition of untracked trades is the likelier labour failure, not a strike. Japan and Germany, home to the sole cold-head and wire sources, are shrinking their working-age populations through the 2030s.
evidence.source: BLS tables 18b and 11b (2025); BLS union tables (2025, 2026); Statistics Bureau of Japan (2024); KfW (1 Jul 2025); labor lens
evidence.changes_if: The contrarian notes welders' median age (39.3) is below the all-worker median, so the "retirement cliff" is a property of one roster, not of the trade. The OEM's roster age is AI-suggested; Human resources confirms.
evidence.confirm_by: Human resources

evidence.claim: P13. The East Coast longshore master contract covering the export port runs to 30 September 2030 with automation protections; the last stoppage (October 2024) lasted three days. The port's hurricane closures are two to three days on its own logs; the closure class that breaches 30 days is a blocked channel (Baltimore, 11 weeks in 2024). The port has spare berth after suspending its newest terminal on 1 August 2026.
evidence.source: ILA (7 Feb 2025); SC Ports Authority (2019, 2024); Maritime Executive (25 Jun 2026); labor, infrastructure, natural disasters lenses
evidence.changes_if: A channel blockage is a low-base-rate event with no schedule. Which terminal the oversize crates use is unconfirmed; Logistics confirms.
evidence.confirm_by: Logistics

evidence.claim: P14. Grid recovery after an inland storm in South Carolina ran about ten days after Helene (2024). The reliability body rates the Carolinas grid elevated from 2027 with winter-morning risk and the Midcontinent grid high from winter 2028 on coal retirements and contracted data-centre load. The Pee Dee basin behind the magnet plant had three 100-year rainfall events in 2015 to 2018, and the design rainfall that continuity plans use will be rewritten no earlier than September 2027.
evidence.source: Duke Energy (30 Sep 2024); NERC Long-Term Reliability Assessment (29 Jan 2026); SC State Climatology Office; NOAA
evidence.changes_if: Grid investment ahead of schedule. The plant's dependence on grid power for liquefaction is AI-suggested; Site operations confirms.
evidence.confirm_by: Site operations

evidence.claim: P15. The hazard classification over the Japanese cold-head source rose in September 2025 (Nankai Trough 30-year probability revised to roughly 60 to 90 percent or higher), and the China plant's city is a named subsidence hotspot with an unexplained 80 to 160 centimetre sea surge in October 2024.
evidence.source: Headquarters for Earthquake Research Promotion (2024, 2025); Science via Asia Times (2024)
evidence.changes_if: Plant locations are AI-suggested; Engineering and Site operations confirm.
evidence.confirm_by: Engineering and Site operations

evidence.claim: P16. Memory makers roughly tripled DRAM contract prices across 2026 and are allocating capacity to AI and server buyers under agreements reported to run into 2028, and mature-node capacity moves partly out of Taiwan by 2028. The 25 percent Section 232 chip tariff of 15 January 2026 exempts non-data-centre industrial uses.
evidence.source: TrendForce (2 Feb, 8 Jul, 30 Sep 2026); Counterpoint (23 Jan 2026); EY (15 Jan 2026)
evidence.changes_if: Allocation easing before 2028; the duration is Panel judgement. The exemption's application to reconstruction processors is AI-suggested; Sourcing confirms.
evidence.confirm_by: Sourcing

evidence.claim: P17. The Federal Reserve policy rate is 3.75 to 4.00 percent (September 2026) with 4.1 percent projected through 2027; producer prices are up 5.4 percent a year; United States hospital margins are 2.5 percent year to date; Medicaid phases down from fiscal 2028 to 2032 by statute; Medicare 2026 rates carry a productivity cut. More than a quarter of Europe's MRI installed base was over ten years old in 2023 and every magnet installed 2016 to 2021 passes that line by 2031.
evidence.source: Federal Reserve (16 Sep 2026); BLS (10 Sep 2026); Kaufman Hall (27 Aug 2026); HANYS (Oct 2025); COCIR (2023)
